Kids love the lights and excitement, and adults get to unwind away from crowded beaches and noisy streets. services.name: Dolphin cruis
services.desc: Hop aboard our vessel and get ready to cruise the stunning waters of Destin, where dolphins love to play in the surf and show off just a few feet from the boat. Our Coast Guard-certified captains know all the best spots around the East Pass, Choctawhatchee Bay, and the Gulf of America, and they’ll take you on a relaxing, scenic journey you won’t forget. These playful creatures often swim right alongside us, leaping, twirling, and riding our wake. Whether you’re a first-timer or a dolphin cruise veteran, every trip with Destin Snorkel is a brand-new adventure. services.name: 360 Tour
services.desc: Explore marine life and shelling locations on Destin Snorkel’s two-stop snorkeling tours. Our two-stop tours are designed for variety, not boredom. The first stop focuses on snorkeling near rock structures with schools of tropical fish. The second stop shifts to calm grass flats perfect for shelling and shallow exploration. This gives you two completely different environments in one trip. Kids stay engaged and adults stay interested. Everyone wins. It’s why this tour is a guest favorite. Marine life sightings often include angelfish, sergeant majors, parrotfish, rays, and crabs. Shelling areas may reveal sand dollars, sea stars, and unique shells. services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: Here’s how SNUBA® lets you explore deeper underwater with no scuba certification required. SNUBA® is what happens when you mix snorkeling and scuba. You breathe underwater using a surface-supplied air hose instead of a tank. There’s no certification required and no heavy gear on your back. You can explore depths around 20 feet comfortably. Movement feels natural and unrestricted. You stay visually connected to the surface. Confidence stays high. Destin Snorkel is the only operator in Destin offering SNUBA®.
